title: Tax break for Fordham Bedford Cluster housing, Bronx
summary: The resolution approves a 40-year property tax exemption for an affordable housing project owned by Mosholu Concourse Housing Development Fund Corporation at two Bronx lots. The exemption runs from June 25, 2021 and depends on compliance with an affordable housing regulatory agreement with the city's Department of Housing Preservation and Development. It can be ended early if the property is not operated or transferred according to that agreement's terms.
